notes:
Nissan units on 29-bit identifiers over the diagnostic socket's CAN pair (500 kbit/s), seen on Qashqai J11, Juke F15 and X-Trail T32. They are in their own profile because a profile has one identifier width; the 11-bit units are in `nissan-infiniti-can`.

The request identifiers are 0x18DA, the unit address and the tester address 0xF1, and the replies swap the two address bytes (ISO 15765-4 normal fixed addressing). That derivation is an inference: opendbc gives the gateway as 0x18DAD0F1, and OBDb gives only a short header (DA15) and a short receive address (15) per unit, whose expansion its schema documents only for six-digit and eight-digit receive addresses. Every row is unconfirmed, and the reply identifiers are the least certain part.

Every address is a fact transcribed from open diagnostic-tool sources; no signal definition is copied. The services are the ones OBDb reads each unit with (service 22, two-byte identifiers), so the profile carries UDS with session 0x01 for all of them; opendbc reads the gateway with service 21.

A vendor handout lists a Nissan secure gateway from 2020, which is not documented in any source here. A unit that stays silent on a newer car is reported as no response, not as a fault.

gateway.description: Gateway, named by opendbc at address 0xD0 (Ecu.gateway 0x18dad0f1)
gateway.source: https://github.com/commaai/opendbc/blob/27fa1c5d8eed3238a0a78c52ff5abb6cdc807bd2/opendbc/car/nissan/fingerprints.py and https://github.com/commaai/opendbc/blob/27fa1c5d8eed3238a0a78c52ff5abb6cdc807bd2/opendbc/car/nissan/values.py (Ecu.gateway 0x18dad0f1, Leaf and X-Trail), read there with service 21

unit-15.description: Unit at address 0x15, which answers engine-related reads in OBDb (header DA15)

unit-18.description: Unit at address 0x18, which answers battery and fuel-related reads in OBDb (header DA18)

unit-2d.description: Unit at address 0x2D, which answers tyre-related reads in OBDb (header DA2D)
unit-2d.source: https://github.com/OBDb/Nissan-Qashqai/blob/031a6e3024ad0f89db69ac3cfa9999e2d2106d13/signalsets/v3/default.json and https://github.com/OBDb/Nissan-Juke/blob/b2c85ced410f8d285f48b2d9da3d66146d538bfe/signalsets/v3/default.json and https://github.com/OBDb/Nissan-X-Trail/blob/e1dc82434b9b557768b7042f59bcd6ded3889918/signalsets/v3/default.json (header DA2D, receive address 2D, service 22)

unit-da.description: Unit at address 0xDA, which answers engine-related reads in OBDb (header DADA)

unit-db.description: Unit at address 0xDB, which answers battery-related reads in OBDb (header DADB)
